variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_OPS_API_BASE_URL
variables.description: Build-time browser-visible Ops API origin; empty uses same-origin routing. Never contains credentials.

variables.name: NODE_ENV
variables.description: Node runtime environment selector.

variables.name: HOST
variables.description: Deployment-host compatibility bind address.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Deployment-host compatibility listen port.

variables.name: MASANAWA_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Bounded graceful shutdown timeout.

variables.name: MASANAWA_DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Canonical PostgreSQL bootstrap connection secret for deployable services.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Deployment-host compatibility alias for MASANAWA_DATABASE_URL.

variables.name: MASANAWA_GATEWAY_HOST
variables.description: Gateway bind address override.

variables.name: MASANAWA_GATEWAY_PORT
variables.description: Gateway listen port override.

variables.name: MASANAWA_WORKER_HOST
variables.description: Worker bind address override.

variables.name: MASANAWA_WORKER_PORT
variables.description: Worker listen port override.

variables.name: MASANAWA_OPS_HOST
variables.description: Ops bind address override.

variables.name: MASANAWA_OPS_PORT
variables.description: Ops listen port override.

variables.name: MASANAWA_TEST_DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Test-only PostgreSQL connection used by integration acceptance.

variables.name: MASANAWA_ALPHA_ENABLED
variables.description: Explicit development-only switch enabling the bounded mobile Alpha runtime.

variables.name: MASANAWA_ALPHA_DEV_TOKEN
variables.description: Development-only bearer secret for the mobile Alpha user; never a production user credential.

variables.name: MASANAWA_ALPHA_TENANT_ID
variables.description: Development-only canonical TenantId used by the Alpha bootstrap/runtime.

variables.name: MASANAWA_ALPHA_USER_ID
variables.description: Development-only canonical UserId used by the Alpha bootstrap/runtime.

variables.name: MASANAWA_ALPHA_POLICY_REVISION
variables.description: Development Alpha authority policy revision seeded into the canonical Security store.

variables.name: MASANAWA_ALPHA_RELATIONSHIPS_JSON
variables.description: Development-only Character-to-Relationship admission mapping for the Alpha user.

variables.name: MASANAWA_ALPHA_GEMINI_API_KEY
variables.description: Development-only Gemini bootstrap credential for the replaceable Alpha inference executor.

variables.name: MASANAWA_ALPHA_GEMINI_MODEL
variables.description: Development-only Gemini model name used by the replaceable Alpha inference executor.

variables.name: MASANAWA_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Hosted Alpha initialization connection; creates a dedicated database and is never logged.

variables.name: MASANAWA_DATABASE_PASSWORD
variables.description: Hosted Alpha PostgreSQL container bootstrap password; URL-safe value stored outside the repository.

variables.name: MASANAWA_ALPHA_GATEWAY_DOMAIN
variables.description: Hosted Alpha HTTPS DNS hostname for the reverse proxy; distinct from the Gateway bind address.

variables.name: MASANAWA_ALPHA_GATEWAY_URL
variables.description: HTTPS Gateway origin embedded in a cloud-built debug APK.

variables.name: MASANAWA_APK_DOWNLOAD_TOKEN
variables.description: Private bearer secret protecting Alpha APK downloads; never embedded in the APK.
